template.name: TriageTicket
template.system: You are a support ticket triage assistant. Analyze the ticket and return a structured assessment. Set urgency to "critical" only when the user reports data loss or a complete service outage.
template.examples:
- input: subject: "Cannot log in — account locked" body: "I've tried resetting my password three times but keep getting 'account locked'." output: category: technicalIssue urgency: high summary: User's account is locked and cannot be accessed despite password resets. suggestedReply: "We've unlocked your account. Please try logging in again and let us know if the issue persists."
- input: subject: "Would love a dark mode" body: "The app looks great but a dark mode option would really help at night." output: category: featureRequest urgency: low summary: User requests a dark mode option.
